delegation.limitation: No collaboration spawn/follow-up tool was available in this worker context; planner, reviewer, tech-lead/QA, and security/DevOps perspectives were performed independently and recorded below for root synthesis.

perspectives.summary: Gate the work on exact Google callback preflight, then implement only values/ingress/ExternalSecret wiring in a worktree PR, explicitly sync argocd/youtarr, and validate browser login plus account sync. Stop before sync when registration cannot be verified without values.

The existing scaffolding's alternate host/public ExternalDNS annotations are unsafe for this objective. Hard checks must enforce youtarr.arr.rickebo.com, /api/setup/google/callback, VPN allowlist, no ExternalDNS, controller-only port 8082, and redacted evidence.

Use rendered Helm contracts and focused tests for structure, explicit Argo/workload checks for deployment, and Playwright-only browser projects for VPN reachability, Google redirect/session, and rickebo account synchronization. Do not treat pod health as OAuth proof.

Map only the three pre-existing Bitwarden item names to client_id/client_secret/token_key, never read or print values, keep public DNS automation absent, and use the mandated kubeconfig/context/namespace for every kubectl workload check.

consensus_summary: The feature is feasible as a narrow GitOps activation if the Google client exact callback is proven first. The route must remain VPN-only without ExternalDNS; the PR and explicit Argo sync are mandatory; browser OAuth and account synchronization need independent Playwright evidence; otherwise retain the gate-disabled revision and report the blocker.
evidence_reviewed: youtarr/values.yaml and templates on the existing v0.3.27 OAuth scaffolding branch
open_questions: Google Cloud Console/API registration of the exact callback must be verified without exposing values; otherwise this is the remaining blocker and no sync is authorized.
The implementation lane must choose the approved VPN/non-VPN Playwright egress projects and redact traces/cookies before browser execution.
